identity_boundary: Physical UI ordinal and name/pixel fingerprint do not establish appearance ID, cyclopedia ID, serverID, or canonical Item identity. Same name/icon does not collapse records.
missing_value_policy: Only visibly read fields are emitted; absent fields are not zero, false, N/A or intrinsic absence. UNKNOWN/N/A/zero are not interchangeable.
private_artifacts: Original PNG remain private on owner Ubuntu; source keys resolve against private evidence root. No images or proprietary assets included.
